title: hieracium caesium subsp. silenii
intro: Hieracium caesium subsp. silenii, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower or Cornflower, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Cornflower include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium caesium subsp. silenii include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
